data.text: kadence ui has no way to make a subtask: 'n' creates a top-level task only, there is no parent key, and the task detail says just 'has a parent' without naming it. Asked by the owner while preparing a live demo (2026-10-17); a person on the board has to drop to the CLI (task add --parent / task parent) for something a kanban user expects in the board.
